source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 <verse ...>...</verse> substring, including markup, whitespace, written forms, and any reading notes. No XML reserialization or Hebrew normalization.

key_decisions.decision: Use the established El Shaddai rendering with its uncertainty noted; keep fruitful, multiply, and assembly as linked covenant vocabulary, with becoming as the result rather than an endpoint.
Render meraashot as by his head rather than asserting a stone pillow; singular stone follows the resumptive verse 18.
Retain the two behold presentations, ascending before descending, and stairway as a provisional rendering of the rare sullam; no architectural reconstruction is asserted.
Choose above-it for alav while noting beside-Jacob as possible; render father Abraham as grandfather to clarify the actual relationship.
Retain dust, all four directions, and the singular you representing Jacob’s line; use the earlier Niphal blessing rendering with the alternative noted.
Place the main-clause boundary at then the LORD provisionally; note that this clause may instead complete the condition.
